cell_line.evidence: To investigate and identify the potential DUBs that stabilize and interact with DDR1, we performed immunoprecipitation of endogenous DDR1 with anti-DDR1 antibody (specific IP) or anti-IgG antibody (negative control) in A549 cells followed by mass spectrometry analysis.

cell_type.evidence: The human non-small cell lung cancer cell line A549 was propagated in F-12K medium (Pricella Biotechnology), which was enriched with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS, VivaCell C04001) and 1% penicillin/streptomycin.
